title: BLFReviewAdjudication
description: Schema for recording authoritative Stage 2 evidence-aware reconciliation of multi-rater human review disagreements.

adjudication_id.description: Unique identifier for this adjudication record.

adjudicator_id.description: Identifier of the expert adjudicator or committee.

review_ids_considered.description: List of individual human review decision IDs reviewed during adjudication.

final_gold_form.description: Authoritative standard Gold surface form established through adjudication.

evidence_ids_used.description: Registered linguistic evidence or grammar citation IDs consulted during adjudication.

rule_correction_needed.description: Whether the adjudication outcome requires modifying an underlying declarative linguistic rule.

affected_rule_id.description: Rule ID requiring update if rule_correction_needed is true.

adjudication_notes.description: Detailed linguistic rationale for the adjudication decision.

adjudication_status.description: Status of the adjudicated outcome for Gold dataset promotion.
